name: 43537 · Maumee, OH
findings: ZIP 43537 (Maumee) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43537 (Maumee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
